provenance: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Modelled on the shape of an ICMM Critical Control Management Material Unwanted Event register as described in ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4 and research/05-architecture/diachronic-recall.md 3, and written for this repository's tests. It is NOT any customer's register and NOT a transcription of an ICMM publication. A deployment replaces this file with the buyer's own register; the loader's refusals are what make that substitution safe.
notes: Two fields per entry carry meaning. 'mue_title' is the register's own wording, kept verbatim so an auditor can match a row to the customer's document; MUE titles name EVENTS. 'label' is the functional rendering that becomes activity_node.label, and it names the WORK, because that is what survives asset re-tagging and org-chart churn. Both are kept so the second can be defended to the person who wrote the first.
